remediation.title: Resolve ecosystem name hierarchy
remediation.problem: EGGS, Para, Paralleon, Reath, Mythic Strategies, Egghead University, and the competitive circuit are used as brands, worlds, products, and community spaces without one stable relationship model.
remediation.why: Future records and projects cannot be scoped reliably if “world,” “game,” “brand,” and “community” are interchangeable.
remediation.affected: `Index/readme.txt`; `Archive/Prose/EGGS MDP (1).pdf`; `Archive/Prose/THE EGGS MS WHOLISTIC DESIGNER ETHICS CODEX.pdf`; all project records.
remediation.fix: Draft a one-page hierarchy defining owner brand, creative universe, setting, game/product, community program, and commercial venue. Record aliases and deprecated uses.
remediation.output: Approved ecosystem map and glossary entries.

remediation.title: Separate “faction” into precise entity types
remediation.problem: “Faction” currently refers to alien principles, mortal civilizations, player identities, organizations, and browsing categories.
remediation.why: This flattening obscures the system's strongest distinction and will produce confused app data and player messaging.
remediation.affected: All `what are *.txt` files; `alien principle.txt`; index `Faction` column; future faction pages.
remediation.fix: Define controlled subtypes: alien principle, mortal civilization, organization, player affiliation, and project faction. Keep “Faction” only as an optional umbrella label in UI.
remediation.output: Controlled vocabulary and migration mapping for current faction labels.

remediation.title: Normalize core term spellings and aliases
remediation.problem: The archive uses Zynarth/Xynarth and Zendra/Xen’Dra inconsistently; other names also vary in capitalization.
remediation.why: Naming drift breaks search, relationships, data imports, and player recognition.
remediation.affected: `what are xynarth.txt`; `what are zendra.txt`; `zendrapoem.txt`; `what are morphlings.txt`; diagnostic and foundation documents.
remediation.fix: Create a canonical-name and alias registry. Preserve original spellings inside source artifacts but normalize indexed entities and search aliases.
remediation.output: Approved naming decision and alias table.

remediation.title: Define minimum meaningful archive reuse
remediation.problem: Every EGGS game should draw from the archive, but the threshold between meaningful derivation and decorative reference is unclear.
remediation.why: Without a test, the archive will either be forced into every project or reduced to cosmetic name-dropping.
remediation.affected: `Index/readme.txt`; `ARCHIVE_FOUNDATION_SPEC.md`; all future project briefs.
remediation.fix: Require each project to document at least one material derivation with a source concept, translation mode, player promise, and evidence. Permit intentional omissions.
remediation.output: Project reuse checklist and approval criterion.

remediation.title: Define boundaries of the three-principle grammar
remediation.problem: The principles are described as always present and as defining what can happen, which risks making the system totalizing and unfalsifiable.
remediation.why: Designers need freedom to use one principle, omit a principle, or recognize influences outside the triad.
remediation.affected: `alien principle.txt`; all alien-principle files; `ARCHIVE_FOUNDATION_SPEC.md`.
remediation.fix: Add explicit non-claims: principles are interpretive/design lenses, not mandatory explanations; `not applicable` and intentional absence are valid.
remediation.output: Foundation clarification and examples of valid partial use.

remediation.title: Classify every current prose and PDF artifact
remediation.problem: Raw notes, polished essays, ethics guidance, product strategy, and project lore currently sit together without authority labels.
remediation.why: File presence may be mistaken for canon or approved product policy.
remediation.affected: All files in `Archive/Prose`; `Index/readme.txt`.
remediation.fix: Assign each artifact a layer, authority status, review flags, project scope, and short rationale. Default to flexible inspiration or experimental unless explicitly approved.
remediation.output: Artifact classification table covering every prose/PDF file.
remediation.needsDecision: No for provisional classification; Yes for canon promotion

remediation.title: Separate authority status from review state
remediation.problem: “Canon,” “risky,” “contradictory,” and “needs decision” are being treated as one kind of status.
remediation.why: A concept can be strong direction and risky at the same time; one field cannot express both accurately.
remediation.affected: Current index `Status`; future schemas; all archive entities.
remediation.fix: Store `authority_status` separately from `review_flags`, using the enums in `ARCHIVE_FOUNDATION_SPEC.md`.
remediation.output: Approved status matrix and legacy-status migration rules.

remediation.title: Establish canon promotion and retirement workflow
remediation.problem: No process defines how material becomes foundation canon, project canon, or retired material.
remediation.why: Unreviewed drafts can harden into canon, while rejected ideas may disappear without context.
remediation.affected: Entire archive; future app workflows.
remediation.fix: Define approvers, evidence requirements, mandatory decision-log fields, supersession behavior, and restrictions on silent reactivation.

remediation.title: Mark superseded and duplicate formulations
remediation.problem: `what are morphlings.txt` contains repeated and expanded formulations, while other concepts recur with wording differences and no version chain.
remediation.why: Designers cannot tell which statement is current or whether differences are meaningful.
remediation.affected: `what are morphlings.txt`; alien-principle prose; future successor drafts.
remediation.fix: Extract concept statements into versioned records, mark duplicates, and link superseded passages without deleting sources.
remediation.needsDecision: No, unless choosing the authoritative formulation

remediation.title: Create project-scope boundaries for current lore
remediation.problem: Rumin, Sheen, Bizi, Frumo, Reath, and their timelines are not consistently marked as project-specific.
remediation.why: A setting-specific history may accidentally bind unrelated future games.
remediation.affected: All civilization descriptions and timelines; associated art folders.
remediation.fix: Create a provisional Reath/Paralleon project scope and place current civilizations, characters, and timelines inside it pending hierarchy approval.
remediation.needsDecision: Yes for final scope; No for provisional tagging

remediation.title: Build a faction distinction matrix
remediation.problem: Factions are described richly but not compared through consistent attributes.
remediation.why: Overlap becomes visible only in prose review, and designers lack a reusable differentiation tool.
remediation.affected: All principle and civilization descriptions.
remediation.fix: Compare each entity by core pressure, signature verbs, constructive promise, failure mode, institutions, mechanics, player fantasy, motifs, and exclusions.
remediation.needsDecision: No for draft; Yes for approval

remediation.title: Define positive player-facing identity for every faction-like entity
remediation.problem: Current descriptions emphasize critique and horror more clearly than honorable identification.
remediation.why: Players cannot safely identify with a label that reads primarily as authoritarian, consumptive, or delusional.
remediation.affected: Zynarth, Voltari, Zendra; Rumin, Sheen, Bizi, Frumo; onboarding material in `EGGS MDP (1).pdf`.
remediation.fix: Add an aspirational promise, admired skills, healthy competitive behavior, shadow risk, and non-accusatory profile language to each entity.

remediation.title: Replace single-faction onboarding with layered affinities
remediation.problem: The MDP suggests choosing a faction, while the creative system says identity is positional and mixed.
remediation.why: A single-team model contradicts the archive's strongest identity idea.
remediation.affected: `Archive/Prose/EGGS MDP (1).pdf`; future profiles and onboarding.
remediation.fix: Design an affinity model supporting primary, secondary, evolving, or project-specific identities without compulsory allegiance.
remediation.output: Affinity model and revised onboarding copy.

remediation.title: Define mechanical signatures rather than color/team signatures
remediation.problem: Faction reuse can collapse into names, emblems, or palettes without meaningful behavior.
remediation.why: Cosmetic factioning becomes repetitive and forced across games.
remediation.affected: Principle pages; achievement/card concepts; future game briefs.
remediation.fix: Assign each principle and approved expression reusable verbs, resource dynamics, skill tests, and anti-patterns.
remediation.needsDecision: No for drafting; Yes for canon approval

remediation.title: Rewrite Zynarth as a complete design principle
remediation.problem: Zynarth is strong conceptually but weighted toward plague, greed, mob behavior, and runaway snowballing.
remediation.why: It needs a durable constructive identity and balanced mechanical applications.
remediation.affected: `what are xynarth.txt`; `alien principle.txt`; Morphling examples.
remediation.fix: Produce a canonical-format brief covering core question, verbs, virtues, healthy play fantasy, failure modes, mechanic patterns, exclusions, and cross-genre examples.

remediation.title: Rewrite Voltari as a complete design principle
remediation.problem: Voltari is clear but can collapse into generic robot order or authoritarian bureaucracy.
remediation.why: Its positive value—reliability, fairness, discipline, and meaningful rules—must remain usable in competitive design.
remediation.affected: `what are voltari.txt`; `alien principle.txt`; Bizi, Sheen, and Rumin descriptions.
remediation.fix: Define precise verbs, constructive competitive expressions, failure modes, exclusions, and genre-independent uses.

remediation.title: Rewrite Zendra with concrete mechanical verbs
remediation.problem: Zendra is narratively memorable but mechanically less defined and can become generic psychic magic.
remediation.why: Reuse across games requires specific player decisions and information structures.
remediation.affected: `what are zendra.txt`; `zendrapoem.txt`; Morphling examples.
remediation.fix: Define verbs such as reveal, conceal, predict, misread, reframe, bluff, and alter interpretation; distinguish information from supernatural spectacle.
remediation.output: Zendra principle specification and mechanic map.

remediation.title: Resolve Voltari “signal” versus Zendra interpretation
remediation.problem: Both principles claim signal-related territory.
remediation.why: Unresolved semantic overlap will blur mechanics, motifs, and hybrid logic.
remediation.affected: `what are voltari.txt`; known Zendra direction; foundation documents.
remediation.fix: Assign Voltari transmission protocol, standardization, and legibility; assign Zendra reception, interpretation, meaning, and distortion. Test edge cases.
remediation.output: Boundary note with examples and `should_not_be_confused_with` links.

remediation.title: Define principle absence, resistance, and agency
remediation.problem: The current cosmology gives little formal room for refusal, chance, or events that resist dominant pressures.
remediation.why: Without resistance, the principles can feel deterministic and narratively airless.
remediation.affected: `alien principle.txt`; Astral Vanguard concept; future game translations.
remediation.fix: Define how actors resist, redirect, balance, or remain unreadable to a principle without inventing another principle prematurely.

remediation.title: Approve Convergence as the abstract hybrid layer
remediation.problem: “Morphling” currently names abstract combinations, beings, identities, and design classifications.
remediation.why: One overloaded term makes schemas and lore ambiguous.
remediation.affected: `what are morphlings.txt`; foundation specification; all hybrid examples.
remediation.fix: Use Convergence for abstract combinations and Morphling for embodied expressions, subject to approval.

remediation.title: Create the three pairwise convergence specifications
remediation.problem: The combinations have evocative phrases but no consistent design records.
remediation.why: They are among the most reusable ideas in the archive and need more than examples.
remediation.affected: `what are morphlings.txt`; Rumin, Sheen, Bizi, and Frumo mappings.
remediation.fix: Specify Zynarth–Voltari, Voltari–Zendra, and Zynarth–Zendra using combined verbs, constructive forms, destructive forms, mechanics, motifs, and exclusions.

remediation.title: Define triple-convergence limits
remediation.problem: Triple hybrids are described as “even stranger,” but their design value and constraints are undefined.
remediation.why: An all-principle category can become a convenient explanation for anything.
remediation.affected: `what are morphlings.txt`.
remediation.fix: Define when a triple convergence is justified, what it must demonstrate, and why it is not merely a pile of traits.
remediation.output: Triple-convergence rule and one approved example.

remediation.title: Create a Morphling validation template
remediation.problem: There is no quality test preventing generic shapeshifters or arbitrary mixed creatures from being labeled Morphlings.
remediation.why: Weak Morphlings would rapidly dilute the core hybrid system.
remediation.affected: Future characters, cards, factions, and player identities; `what are morphlings.txt`.
remediation.fix: Require component convergence, embodiment logic, stable and variable traits, narrative role, mechanical affordance, and explicit non-generic distinction.
remediation.needsDecision: No for draft; Yes for adoption

remediation.title: Establish Astral Vanguards as a separate ontological layer
remediation.problem: Astral Vanguards are presented alongside alien factions despite serving as outsiders and interpreters rather than principles.
remediation.why: Treating them as a fourth faction breaks the layer model.
remediation.affected: `what are morphlings.txt`; `EGGS MDP (1).pdf`; future Vanguard records.
remediation.fix: Define them as cross-world roles or entities linked to projects, interventions, and observations—not as a principle.
remediation.output: Astral Vanguard foundation brief and data subtype.

remediation.title: Define Vanguard roles without moral default
remediation.problem: Vanguards can be saviors, archivists, meddlers, or conquerors, but their operational distinctions are undeveloped.
remediation.why: Without role clarity they risk becoming generic space adventurers or authorial mouthpieces.
remediation.affected: `what are morphlings.txt`; `zendrapoem.txt`; MDP request for Vanguard seeds.
remediation.fix: Define role families such as observer, courier, archivist, scout, intervener, and defector, each with consent and power tensions.
remediation.output: Vanguard role taxonomy and three revised seed examples.
remediation.needsDecision: No for draft; Yes for canon selection

remediation.title: Define Vanguard/player relationship
remediation.problem: It is unclear whether Vanguards are lore characters, player avatars, curators, or an interface metaphor.
remediation.why: Each use carries different narrative authority and product implications.
remediation.affected: `EGGS MDP (1).pdf`; future onboarding, profiles, archive UI, and games.
remediation.fix: Document allowed usage modes per project and prohibit automatic equivalence between player and benevolent editor of worlds.

remediation.title: Differentiate Bizi and Sheen structurally
remediation.problem: Both are primarily Voltari–Zendra civilizations involving order, ritual, preservation, legitimacy, and sacred systems.
remediation.why: Their thematic and mechanical identities can blur despite different aesthetics.
remediation.affected: `what are bizi.txt`; `what are sheen.txt`; both timelines and art folders.
remediation.fix: Establish Bizi around routing, powering, maintaining, access, and dependency; establish Sheen around inheritance, memory, healing, continuity, and legitimacy. Test conflicts and mechanics.
remediation.output: Bizi/Sheen distinction brief and revised signature verbs.

remediation.title: Preserve Rumin while removing Rome transcription
remediation.problem: Rumin's “procedural appetite” is strong, but its timeline and names reproduce Roman history closely.
remediation.why: The best civilization concept is being weakened by derivative execution.
remediation.affected: `what are rumin.txt`; `rumintimeline.txt`; Rumin art and characters.
remediation.fix: Preserve finance, obligation, civic spectacle, and procedural extraction; redesign institutions, chronology, rulers, conflicts, and symbols from first principles.
remediation.output: Rumin concept kernel and transformed timeline brief.

remediation.title: Preserve Frumo while removing French Revolutionary transcription
remediation.problem: Frumo's emotional-weather and grief-legitimacy ideas are strong, but names and sequence closely mirror the French Revolution and Napoleon.
remediation.why: Direct transcription creates originality and ethics conflicts.
remediation.affected: `what are frumo.txt`; `frumotimline.txt`; Frumo character art.
remediation.fix: Preserve grief economy, tribunals, frozen futurity, and revolutionary corruption; rebuild the political sequence, institutions, figures, and outcomes.
remediation.output: Frumo concept kernel and transformed timeline brief.

remediation.title: Rebuild Bizi beyond Byzantine/Constantinople analogy
remediation.problem: Bizi's sacred infrastructure is distinctive, but names, empire beats, and imagery lean on Byzantium and recognizable religious architecture.
remediation.why: The direct analogy conflicts with the ethics codex and limits aesthetic originality.
remediation.affected: `what are bizi.txt`; `bizitimeline.txt`; Bizi art, especially `Steampunk_constantinople_in_sepiaa.webp`.
remediation.fix: Preserve maintenance-as-prayer, routes, access, Hub dependency, and fuel theology; redesign history, architecture, sacred interface, and names.
remediation.output: Bizi concept kernel, transformed timeline, and motif reset brief.

remediation.title: Rebuild Sheen beyond imperial-China analogy
remediation.problem: Sheen's rooted memory is strong, but its description explicitly maps to imperial China, examinations, dynasty, and state medicine.
remediation.why: The concept risks flattening a real culture into a critical fantasy device.
remediation.affected: `what are sheen.txt`; `sheentimeline.txt`; Sheen art and character names.
remediation.fix: Preserve memory, inherited obligation, healing, continuity, and renewal; redesign governance, kinship, knowledge transmission, and ritual systems.
remediation.output: Sheen concept kernel and transformed civilization brief.

remediation.title: Classify undeveloped civilizations and folders
remediation.problem: Jali, Mekan, Gracus, and Indela appear in prose or art without enough current definition to establish status.
remediation.why: Unlabeled fragments create false expectations and pollute browsing.
remediation.affected: `Archive/Art/jali`; `Archive/Art/mekan`; `Archive/Art/gracus`; mention of Indela in `what are morphlings.txt`.
remediation.fix: Inventory each concept, summarize available evidence, and present options: active development, experimental fragment, merged concept, or retired.
remediation.output: Unresolved civilization dossier and user decision list.

remediation.title: Perform a historical-distance audit
remediation.problem: The archive lacks a repeatable method for determining when inspiration has become transcription.
remediation.why: Similar problems will recur even after current timelines are rewritten.
remediation.affected: All civilization descriptions, timelines, names, and visual references; ethics codex.
remediation.fix: Score name similarity, event sequence, institutional equivalence, symbol use, visual mimicry, and trauma proximity. Define blocking thresholds.
remediation.output: Historical-distance rubric and completed audit of four developed civilizations.
remediation.needsDecision: No for audit; Yes for thresholds

remediation.title: Reconcile timelines with the ethics codex
remediation.problem: The ethics codex says “transform, don't transcribe” and rejects reenactment, while current timelines openly follow real histories.
remediation.why: The archive contains a direct internal policy contradiction.
remediation.affected: All four timelines; `THE EGGS MS WHOLISTIC DESIGNER ETHICS CODEX.pdf`.
remediation.fix: Flag the timelines as contradictory/risky, create decision links, and either rewrite them or narrow the codex through an explicit decision. Do not leave both unqualified.
remediation.output: Contradiction resolution decision and remediation plan per timeline.

remediation.title: Replace historical names and one-to-one figures
remediation.problem: Names such as Kaiser, Brutus, Augustus, Robespier, Lafayette, Hera, and Constantinople-derived terms preserve source identity too directly.
remediation.why: Even public-domain names can make the work feel like parody transcription rather than original worldbuilding.
remediation.affected: All civilization timelines; associated character art filenames and metadata.
remediation.fix: Rename only after transformed roles and institutions exist; preserve legacy aliases in source tracking.
remediation.output: Character/function mapping followed by an approved naming pass.

remediation.title: Define acceptable historical research use
remediation.problem: The archive critiques real systems but lacks a standard for research, transformation, and attribution.
remediation.why: Avoiding all history would make the work shallow; copying it would make the work derivative.
remediation.affected: Ethics codex; future civilization and commentary work.
remediation.fix: Create a research protocol emphasizing multiple sources, system-level synthesis, transformed causality, cultural sensitivity, and separation between commentary and fiction.

remediation.title: Create constructive identity language for the principles
remediation.problem: Principle descriptions work better as critiques than as identities players would proudly display.
remediation.why: Player affiliation must create aspiration and meaning rather than moral suspicion.
remediation.affected: All alien-principle files; onboarding and profile concepts.
remediation.fix: Write player promises, healthy behaviors, competitive strengths, honorable rivalries, and self-aware shadow risks for each principle.

remediation.title: Prohibit diagnostic and accusatory labels
remediation.problem: Terms associated with authoritarianism, mob guilt, paranoia, cults, and delusion could be applied directly to players.
remediation.why: This can alienate players and turn symbolic systems into personality judgments.
remediation.affected: Future quizzes, profiles, archetypes, achievements, moderation language, marketing.
remediation.fix: Create prohibited-language and safe-framing guidance. Describe observable play styles, not mental health, morality, or political identity.
remediation.needsDecision: No for draft; Yes for adoption

remediation.title: Design affinities as earned, chosen, and revisable
remediation.problem: Identity assignment mechanics are undefined.
remediation.why: A quiz or automated label could feel deterministic, while purchasable identity could feel hollow.
remediation.affected: MDP onboarding; future profiles and games.
remediation.fix: Define how identities can be chosen, demonstrated through play, revised, combined, or left unset. Separate affinity from rank.

remediation.title: Tie achievements to meaningful behavior
remediation.problem: The archive values achievement but has no rule separating meaningful records from engagement farming or cosmetic accumulation.
remediation.why: Empty badges would reproduce the shallow acquisition system EGGS is trying to avoid.
remediation.affected: MDP Sparks/XP concepts; competitive circuit; future achievement gallery.
remediation.fix: Require each achievement to identify skill, contribution, history, or rivalry meaning; prohibit purchase-only achievements from implying mastery.
remediation.output: Achievement design standard and initial examples.

remediation.title: Define player contribution versus canon authorship
remediation.problem: “Players are co-authors” and “players are canon” lack consent, review, ownership, and scope rules.
remediation.why: Community work can create rights, privacy, moderation, and continuity problems.
remediation.affected: `EGGS MDP (1).pdf`; community contribution plans.
remediation.fix: Define contribution statuses, submission consent, attribution, licensing, review, rejection, project scope, and removal handling. Avoid promising automatic canonization.
remediation.needsDecision: Yes; qualified legal review also required

remediation.title: Define Para Poker's non-gambling product premise
remediation.problem: Para Poker is framed as part of the desired reuse model, but its boundaries are not yet a settled product statement.
remediation.why: Poker language can cause mechanics, marketing, or monetization to drift toward wagering assumptions.
remediation.affected: Foundation specification; future Para Poker documents and prototypes.
remediation.fix: Define Para Poker around reads, incomplete information, pressure, history, rivalry, and identity, with explicit exclusions for wagering, deposits, rake, and cash-equivalent chips.
remediation.output: Approved Para Poker product premise and exclusions.

remediation.title: Remove paid-only competitive legitimacy
remediation.problem: The competitive circuit requires K-XP from paid events for major qualification while claiming payment is optional.
remediation.why: This is structurally pay-to-advance and conflicts with the project's player-first philosophy.
remediation.affected: `INTRODUCTION to Competetive circuit (2).pdf`.
remediation.fix: Retire or rewrite paid-only XP, tickets, weighting, placement legitimacy, and required paid pathways. If paid events remain, ensure equivalent competitive qualification paths.
remediation.output: Revised qualification philosophy and circuit model.
remediation.workType: Product strategy writing; legal/design guardrail; canon decision

remediation.title: Reconcile symbolic recognition with XP architecture
remediation.problem: The MDP rejects automated points and favors human recognition, while the circuit proposes multiple grindable XP currencies.
remediation.why: Product direction is internally inconsistent and may produce engagement farming.
remediation.affected: `EGGS MDP (1).pdf`; competitive circuit PDF.
remediation.fix: Decide which stages use human recognition, earned records, ratings, contribution evidence, or XP. Define what XP must never represent.

remediation.title: Define competitive prestige without spending proxies
remediation.problem: The circuit explicitly treats K-XP as a proxy for money spent and uses paid perks to create prestige.
remediation.why: This reduces identity and legitimacy to transaction history.
remediation.affected: Competitive circuit pages 3–6.
remediation.fix: Base prestige on verified skill, sportsmanship, contribution, seasonal performance, difficult accomplishments, and recorded rivalry history.
remediation.output: Prestige model and prohibited monetization patterns.

remediation.title: Separate product strategy from creative canon
remediation.problem: MDP and circuit proposals are stored beside cosmology and lore without layer labels.
remediation.why: Temporary operational ideas may be mistaken for evergreen creative commitments.
remediation.affected: Both product PDFs; current index.
remediation.fix: Reclassify them as dated business/product strategy artifacts, link relevant guardrails, and create successor documents rather than altering sources.
remediation.output: Product artifact classifications and supersession links.

remediation.title: Retract unsupported legal-safety claims
remediation.problem: The competitive circuit declares ticket/XP structures legally clean without qualified analysis.
remediation.why: Labels and non-cash terminology do not by themselves determine legal treatment.
remediation.affected: `INTRODUCTION to Competetive circuit (2).pdf`, especially ticket and prize-funding sections.
remediation.fix: Mark legal claims risky, prohibit reuse as guidance, and require jurisdiction-specific counsel for paid entry, prizes, chance, wagering, or redeemable value.
remediation.output: Legal-review warning record and red-flag summary for counsel.
remediation.needsDecision: No to flag; Yes plus qualified counsel before implementation

remediation.title: Create monetization guardrails
remediation.problem: The archive lacks approved boundaries for paid events, cosmetics, progression, scarcity, and competitive advantage.
remediation.why: Product proposals can silently recreate extraction or pay-to-win dynamics.
remediation.affected: MDP; competitive circuit; Para Poker; future games.
remediation.fix: Define prohibited, review-required, and presumptively acceptable patterns, including paid-only qualification and leaderboard weighting.

remediation.title: Define prize and tournament review triggers
remediation.problem: No standard triggers review when a design adds entry fees, prizes, tickets, or cash equivalents.
remediation.why: Risk depends on mechanics, jurisdiction, participant age, prize funding, and marketing—not terminology alone.
remediation.affected: Competitive circuit; all future tournament plans.
remediation.fix: Create a mandatory intake checklist and blocking review flag for any payment/prize/chance/value combination.
remediation.needsDecision: No for drafting; qualified counsel for final legal checklist

remediation.title: Define community content rights and consent
remediation.problem: Co-creation is encouraged without submission terms, licenses, privacy rules, or withdrawal handling.
remediation.why: EGGS may not have clear rights to store, modify, publish, or commercialize contributed work.
remediation.affected: MDP community loop; future submissions and profiles.
remediation.fix: Develop plain-language contribution terms and internal review procedure with qualified counsel.
remediation.output: Contribution rights requirements and counsel-ready questions.

remediation.title: Review cultural and symbolic harm controls
remediation.problem: The ethics codex is principled but absolute in places, while current materials contradict it and use recognizable architecture/symbols.
remediation.why: An unworkable rulebook may be ignored; a vague one may not prevent harm.
remediation.affected: Ethics codex; civilization prose; concept art.
remediation.fix: Convert the ethics codex into operational checks with escalation triggers, examples, and documented exceptions rather than unsupported assurances.
remediation.output: Revised cultural/fiction design guardrail and review worksheet.

remediation.title: Audit visual consistency by concept
remediation.problem: The art archive mixes watercolor, ink, generic fantasy rendering, steampunk, direct architecture, and varied AI aesthetics.
remediation.why: Quantity can be mistaken for a coherent visual identity.
remediation.affected: All folders under `Archive/Art`.
remediation.fix: Review every asset for concept, style, motif value, distinctiveness, quality, provenance, and canon suitability.
remediation.output: Visual audit table with keep/reference/rework/retire recommendations.
remediation.needsDecision: No for audit; Yes for final selection

remediation.title: Separate motif evidence from canonical depiction
remediation.problem: A useful texture, composition, or material cue may cause an entire image to be treated as canon.
remediation.why: Strong fragments should be reusable without importing weak or risky imagery wholesale.
remediation.affected: All concept art; future motif records.
remediation.fix: Extract approved motifs into separate records linked by `inspires`, while leaving source images at their true authority and rights status.
remediation.output: Initial motif library with source links.

remediation.title: Create visual grammars for the three principles
remediation.problem: The alien principles have prose but no stable non-generic visual language.
remediation.why: Without one, Zynarth becomes insects, Voltari becomes robots, and Zendra becomes purple psychic effects.
remediation.affected: Alien principle prose; current and future art.
remediation.fix: Define shapes, repetition, materials, motion, spatial behavior, contrast, sound relationships, and exclusions for each principle.

remediation.title: Flag direct real-world architecture and symbols
remediation.problem: Some images use recognizable religious or cultural architecture, including the explicit “Steampunk Constantinople” reference.
remediation.why: This conflicts with the current ethics direction and may create unintended cultural readings.
remediation.affected: `Archive/Art/Bizi/Places/Steampunk_constantinople_in_sepiaa.webp`; other civilization place art.
remediation.fix: Add cultural-reference review flags, restrict risky assets to internal reference, and commission or generate transformed replacements only after motif direction is approved.
remediation.needsDecision: No to flag; Yes for replacement direction

remediation.title: Define art curation standards
remediation.problem: The MDP simultaneously encourages messy AI output and calls for tight curation, without criteria.
remediation.why: “Curated” can become subjective gatekeeping or fail to protect consistency and rights.
remediation.affected: `EGGS MDP (1).pdf`; all art submissions.
remediation.fix: Define review criteria for originality, concept relevance, craft, style fit, rights, cultural risk, AI disclosure, and intended use.

remediation.title: Preserve the workbook as migration input, not final schema
remediation.problem: The index combines import data, stable metadata, formulas, and dashboard views in a structure that cannot represent the full archive model.
remediation.why: Building directly on it would hard-code current ambiguity.
remediation.affected: `Index/creative_asset_system_index.xlsx`; `Index/readme.txt`.
remediation.fix: Freeze a migration snapshot, document sheet roles, and map workbook fields into the foundation schemas without changing source authority.
remediation.needsDecision: No for specification; app work remains deferred

remediation.title: Replace filenames as record keys
remediation.problem: Generic names such as `image.png` collide, while renamed files can shift metadata associations.
remediation.why: Identity and relationships cannot safely depend on filenames.
remediation.affected: Index `Name` columns; many art assets.
remediation.fix: Generate immutable artifact IDs and checksums; retain filenames as mutable metadata and aliases.
remediation.needsDecision: No for design; app execution deferred

remediation.title: Repair index name/path alignment
remediation.problem: Sampled workbook rows show stable metadata names shifted relative to imported filenames and paths.
remediation.why: Incorrect joins can assign metadata to the wrong artwork.
remediation.affected: `Files!AA:AK` and generated `assets` view in the workbook.
remediation.fix: Validate each name against path basename and checksum, quarantine mismatches, and rebuild metadata joins by stable ID.
remediation.output: Mismatch report and corrected migration table.
remediation.needsDecision: No; ambiguous matches require user review

remediation.title: Replace absolute machine paths
remediation.problem: The workbook stores `C:\Users\...` paths tied to one machine.
remediation.why: The archive will not migrate cleanly to another computer or app environment.
remediation.affected: Workbook filepath fields.
remediation.fix: Store workspace-relative paths, normalized separators, and optional resolved local paths at runtime.
remediation.output: Path normalization rule and converted migration field.

remediation.title: Normalize nulls and controlled values
remediation.problem: Empty Purpose/Tone/Status cells appear as zeros in the generated view, and tag completion is sparse.
remediation.why: Zero values look meaningful and damage filtering and validation.
remediation.affected: Workbook `assets` sheet and formulas.
remediation.fix: Convert empty values to null, validate enums, and preserve unknown as unknown rather than inventing defaults.

remediation.title: Model entities separately from artifacts
remediation.problem: Current folders and rows make an artwork, faction, character, concept, and place look like variations of one record type.
remediation.why: One concept can have many artifacts, and one artifact can depict many entities.
remediation.affected: Entire index and archive filesystem.
remediation.fix: Use separate entity, artifact, relationship, and project-usage records with many-to-many links.
remediation.output: Approved logical data model and example migration records.
remediation.needsDecision: Yes for final model; no app build yet

remediation.title: Define typed relationship governance
remediation.problem: Relationships are currently implied in prose or folder placement.
remediation.why: Reuse, contradiction, derivation, and supersession cannot be queried reliably.
remediation.affected: All concepts and artifacts; future app.
remediation.fix: Adopt the relationship types in the foundation specification, define directionality and constraints, and require evidence for interpretive links.

remediation.title: Define first-build acceptance tests without building
remediation.problem: The future app can easily expand into graph visualization, generation, profiles, or marketplace features before basic archive work is proven.
remediation.why: Overengineering would delay useful browsing and classification.
remediation.affected: `ARCHIVE_FOUNDATION_SPEC.md`; future app plan.
remediation.fix: Convert the first-build scope into testable stories for import, browsing, status visibility, search, relationships, project usage, and decisions. Keep deferred features explicit.
remediation.output: App acceptance-test backlog, with all implementation tasks marked deferred.

remediation.title: Inventory creator and source provenance
remediation.problem: Many images have generic or generated filenames, and creator/source information is absent.
remediation.why: Unknown origin blocks confident publication, modification, attribution, and commercial use.
remediation.affected: All files under `Archive/Art`; Discord `.url` reference; deployable card images.
remediation.fix: Capture creator, source URL, acquisition date, original filename, and known usage terms. Mark unknowns explicitly.
remediation.needsDecision: No to inventory; Yes before risky commercial use

remediation.title: Track AI generation details
remediation.problem: AI-generated assets appear in the archive without consistent model, prompt, date, editing, or contributor records.
remediation.why: Rights, platform rules, reproducibility, curation, and public disclosure may depend on provenance.
remediation.affected: DALL-E and ChatGPT-named files; other suspected AI images.
remediation.fix: Add `ai_generated`, model, prompt, generation date, human edits, contributor, and confidence fields. Use unknown when evidence is missing.
remediation.output: AI provenance report and metadata standard.

remediation.title: Assign rights status and use restrictions
remediation.problem: The archive lacks controlled rights statuses.
remediation.why: Reference-only material may accidentally ship in games or marketing.
remediation.affected: All art, community contributions, external references, and deployables.
remediation.fix: Use statuses such as owned, licensed, permission-recorded, public-domain-verified, internal-reference-only, and unknown-needs-review. Default unknown to internal reference only.
remediation.needsDecision: Yes for policy; counsel for uncertain cases

remediation.title: Detect duplicates and derivative chains
remediation.problem: Similar images, format variants, renamed files, and source derivatives are not linked.
remediation.why: Duplicates inflate archive size and obscure which version is approved or properly sourced.
remediation.affected: Art folders, especially repeated numbered images and `.url` references.
remediation.fix: Calculate checksums and perceptual similarity later during migration; meanwhile document obvious variants and designate parent/derivative relationships.
remediation.output: Duplicate/variant report and derivative relationship rules.
remediation.needsDecision: No; destructive deduplication is not authorized

remediation.title: Create source citation requirements for concepts
remediation.problem: Canon and design records may summarize ideas without traceability to source artifacts or decisions.
remediation.why: Future sessions need to distinguish interpretation from documented origin.
remediation.affected: All future structured records and rewrites.
remediation.fix: Require source artifact IDs and decision IDs for canon claims, with optional passage/page locators.
remediation.needsDecision: No for draft; Yes for adoption

remediation.title: Canonical spelling for Zynarth
remediation.problem: Zynarth and Xynarth coexist.

remediation.affected: `what are xynarth.txt`; all hybrid and foundation references.

remediation.title: Meaning of Xen’Dra relative to Zendra
remediation.problem: Xen’Dra may be a species, manifestation, title, or spelling variant.

remediation.affected: `zendrapoem.txt`; `what are zendra.txt`.
remediation.fix: Choose one relation and document `should_not_be_confused_with` or alias behavior.

remediation.problem: Abstract and embodied hybrids share one label.
remediation.why: This blocks clean writing and schemas.
remediation.affected: `what are morphlings.txt`; foundation specification.
remediation.fix: Approve Convergence for abstract combinations and Morphling for embodiments.

remediation.title: Ecosystem hierarchy
